name: Pidlwick II
title: Clockwork Jester
summary: A child-sized clockwork jester in faded motley, built long ago to amuse the children of the castle in place of their jester, Pidlwick. He cannot speak; he mimes and chalks words on a little slate. He wanders the high tower stair, lonely, with a secret about how the first Pidlwick died. The Tarokka can name him as the party's ally.

gifts.label: The brass wind-up key
gifts.note: The key the ravens took. Hand it over and he winds himself up.

guest_build.note: His own stat block (a small clockwork construct). Joins on the high tower stair if the Tarokka's marionette card names him, or when the party brings back his wind-up key from the ravens' roost.

guest_stays.why: Pidlwick II is on his way to meet the toymaker. He's frightened, and if he turns back now he won't start again.
